key_insight: Synthetic data can support valid scientific inference if the current task is exchangeable with historical real-data tasks, enabling provable guarantees despite bias or misspecification.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical framework for safely using LLM-generated samples, autoraters, and other synthetic outputs in evaluation pipelines when real-data benchmarks from related tasks exist.
method: Define task exchangeability as a mathematical match between the target task and past tasks with real data.
Build inference procedures that remain valid under this exchangeability assumption.
Extend the framework to offer guarantees even when exchangeability is imperfect.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations on public opinion surveys using silicon samples and on AI evaluation using autoraters.
watch_item: The approach depends on finding sufficiently related historical tasks; if that match is weak, validity guarantees may degrade.
paper_title: Valid Inference with Synthetic Data via Task Exchangeability
